This week Drew and Kara head into the Lupton entrance of the Mack Lake ORV Area in the Huron National Forest. They're out to do some tarp camping before deer season starts and Kara gets stuck inside. But this trip is about adventure and adventure is had. Join them as they pitch a tarp, cook vegetables over a campfire, and watch Kara make a new friend!!!
